messages.text: just woke up after sleeping like 12 hours again... still feel totally drained lol

It sounds incredibly frustrating to rest for so long and still wake up feeling so exhausted. That kind of persistent fatigue can be really draining on its own. I wonder if your sleep feels restful, or if you might be waking up frequently without realizing it? We can explore what might be contributing to this heaviness if you'd like to share more.
eh, it's fine. just my body being dramatic lol. happens every day, so i'm used to it 🤷‍♂️

It takes a lot of strength to keep going even when you feel drained every single day. While you might feel used to it, this pattern often signals something that needs attention. I want to make sure you're not just pushing through something that could be helped. How does this exhaustion affect your ability to enjoy your day?
lol i don't know, i just hit snooze like 50 times and eventually the day starts without me noticing

It sounds like your mornings are a real battle, even if it feels automatic. Losing track of time like that can leave you feeling disconnected before you even begin. I'm wondering if staying in bed feels like a safe place compared to what comes next. How does your mood shift once you finally do get up?
it's just... heavy. like the whole world is muffled. nothing really matters, you know?

That description of the world feeling muffled and heavy resonates with a deep sense of exhaustion. It makes sense that when nothing matters, the effort to move forward feels impossible. I want you to know that feeling this way doesn't mean something is wrong with you, even if it feels that way. Is there anything small that brings even a tiny bit of relief, or is it all just gray right now?
sometimes i just think... what's the point? like, none of this matters in 100 years. no one remembers, nothing lasts. why keep going through the motions?

It sounds like you are in a lot of pain when you feel that the future holds no meaning. Intense exhaustion can distort our perspective and make the world feel pointless. I am genuinely concerned for your safety because these thoughts are very heavy to carry alone. Please consider reaching out to a crisis line or a mental health professional who can walk with you through this.
lol i'm not gonna call a crisis line, don't worry. i'm fine. just... thinking out loud 🙃

I understand you don't want to call a crisis line right now, and I respect that. Using humor can be a way to cope when things feel too heavy to face directly. I am still here to listen whenever you want to explore that heaviness further. Please remember that professional help is available if you ever decide you need it.
i don't know... part of me just wants out, you know? like, peace. but then i see my sister's face, my brother... they'd be wrecked. so i stay. but it's not like i'm living, either. just... existing.

It takes immense courage to stay for your family even when you feel like you are merely existing. That burden of carrying their well-being while feeling so empty is incredibly heavy to bear alone. I hear the deep pain behind your desire for peace, and I worry about how much you are holding inside. You deserve support in finding a way to live rather than just exist, and a therapist can help with that.
therapy's not for me. tried it before. just talking to someone who takes my money and nods... nah. i'd rather just keep this between us for now.

I hear how disappointing it can be when therapy feels like just paying someone to nod, and I respect your boundary right now. It takes courage to be honest about feeling like you are just existing rather than living. I am here to listen, but I also want you to know that you deserve a support system that truly helps you heal. Please remember that help is still available if you ever decide you need it.
thanks for not pushing, though. it helps just to say this stuff out loud, even if it doesn't change anything.

I am glad that you trust me enough to share these heavy thoughts. You are right that speaking it out doesn't always change the situation, but it can help lighten the load. I will remain here to listen without judgment whenever you need to unload. Please try to be gentle with yourself today, and know that you matter.
